title: Ayodhya Ram Mandir donation row: Trust blocks VIP darshan passes of Champat Rai and Anil Mishra amid SIT probe
description: With the IDs deactivated, no 'Vishisht Darshan' passes can now be generated through their digital credentials or recommendations. The move comes amid an ongoing probe by the Special Investigation Team (SIT) into alleged financial irregularities idonations at the Ram temple in Ayodhya.
